investigation_notes.Observed Command: Get-ChildItem C:\Users -Recurse -Include *.kdbx,*.pst,*.docx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length | Export-Csv C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv -NoTypeInformation
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command was executed that recursively enumerates user directories for specific file types and exports the results to a CSV file on the host. This behavior suggests data discovery aimed at locating sensitive documents, aided by the use of a recursive search and the export to a common program data path. Given the nature of the target file types and the silent error handling, the activity appears suspicious and warrants escalation as a potential data collection or exfiltration attempt.
